title: incident-response config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the incident-response skill

mode.description: Which part of the incident response procedure to run. 'full' runs all 10 steps. 'triage_only' runs steps 1-4. 'postmortem_only' runs step 9 (requires incident context). 'classify_only' runs step 2.

incident_title.description: Short description of the incident, e.g., 'Payment API returning 500 errors'

severity.description: Pre-classified severity. If omitted, the skill will help classify.

started_at.description: When the incident started (ISO 8601). Used to calculate durations.

resolved_at.description: When the incident was resolved (ISO 8601). Required for postmortem_only mode.

affected_services.description: List of services or systems affected, e.g., ['api-server', 'payment-service', 'postgres-primary']

affected_regions.description: AWS regions or geographic areas affected, e.g., ['us-east-1', 'eu-west-1']

commander.description: Name or handle of the incident commander

communication_channels.description: Which communication channels to include guidance for

infrastructure.description: Primary infrastructure platform — affects diagnostic commands and mitigation strategies

monitoring_stack.description: Monitoring and alerting tools in use — affects log query and alert examples

include_templates.description: Whether to include Slack, email, and status page message templates in the output

include_commands.description: Whether to include diagnostic shell commands (kubectl, aws cli, etc.)

postmortem_context.description: Context for postmortem_only mode — provide what you know about the incident

mitigation_applied.description: What was done to restore service

timeline_notes.description: Raw timeline notes, e.g., ['14:00 deploy went out', '14:12 alerts fired']
